jurisdictions_federation.a_box_s_role_is: Indima yebhokisi yisethe samashaneli esiwakhe — isinye sizakile, sicelwe, sivunyelwe, futhi sijoyinwe ngokuzimela. Amashaneli azizethulile ayikhetho lenqalasizinda yomsebenzi; amashaneli alawulwayo ahamba ngokuvuma kwemitha emibili yenethiwe (ibhodi yomsebenzi, noma uhulumeni ohleli esihlalweni).
jurisdictions_federation.adopt_this_inst: Faka le nsizakalo eqoqweni elikhona njengekhophi yesibuko efundeka kuphela yamairekhodi lomphakathi — ayinalo igunya. Ngokhiye wokujoyina iyavunyelwa khona manje; ngaphandle kwalo, isicelo sibekwa emgqeni ukuze umsebenzi omphathisayizinda aqinisekise.
jurisdictions_federation.approving_an_ad: Ukuvuma ukufakwa kuvumela ikhophi yesibuko efundeka kuphela (engenalo igunya). Ukufunda nokubhala kuyinkalo eyahlukile yolawulo — okunqumwa uhulumeni ohleli esihlalweni wendawo yegunya (Art. V §7) noma, lapho kungekho, ibhodi yomsebenzi esebenza ngaleso sikhathi — hhayi ngokuchofoza ikonsoli.
jurisdictions_federation.cloudflare_dns_: ithokeni lokuhlela i-Cloudflare DNS (igcinwe ngokufihliwe; ngeke isibonakale futhi)
jurisdictions_federation.copy_this_invit: Kopisha lo khiye wesimemo manje — uzobonakala kanye kuphela:

jurisdictions_federation.each_request_s_: Isimo sokuvuma esiphilayo sesicelo ngasinye. Ukuvuma kuqhuba ukuqinisekisa kwebhodi yomsebenzi (Imitha A) bese kuqinisekisa; uhulumeni ohleli esihlalweni uvuma ngokuvota kwaningi elikhethekile (Imitha B). Imitha C ukuvumelana kwabalingani abathintekayo ngomshaneli osebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba somlingani.

jurisdictions_federation.join_key_option: Ikhiye lokujoyina (akudingeki — shiya isikhala ukuze ucele ukuqinisekiswa)
jurisdictions_federation.leave_the_clust: Ufuna ukushiya iqoqo? Le nsizakalo iziyeka ukuba ikhophi yesibuko efundeka kuphela.

jurisdictions_federation.no_peers_yet_di: Akukho ontanga okwamanje — thola omunye usebenzisa ifederation:peer:discover <url>.
jurisdictions_federation.probe_a_peer_ov: Hlola ontanga kuyo yonke indlela yokuthutha (mesh:doctor)
jurisdictions_federation.read_write_is_n: Ukufunda nokubhala akunikwa ngokuhlanganisa. Ngemuva kokuba uyikhophi yesibuko, uthumela isicelo sokufunda nokubhala; uhulumeni womphathi kumele akuvume ngeningi elikhethekile labahlali bendawo yegunya yakho neningi elikhethekile lendawo yegunya yomvoti (Art. V §7). Kuphela lapho igunya lishintsha bese i-bundle yokusebenza eqinisiwe idluliswa.

Ukufunda nokubhala akunikwa ngokuhlanganisa. Lokhu kuthumela isicelo kumphathi; uhulumeni wakhe kumele akuvume ngeningi elikhethekile labahlali bendawo yegunya yakho neningi elikhethekile lendawo yegunya yomvoti (Art. V §7). Kuphela lapho igunya lishintsha bese i-bundle yokusebenza eqinisiwe idluliswa. Le nkinga ayigcini lutho njengegunya kuze kube yilapho.
jurisdictions_federation.sign_in_as_oper: Ngena njengomsebenzi ukuze uthole, uxhumane, futhi uhlole ontanga — noma usebenzise itheminali: php artisan mesh:gates, mesh:doctor <peer>.
jurisdictions_federation.the_host_s_publ: Irekhodi lomphakathi lomphathi — lihlehliswa njalo (lokhu kusho ukuba ikhophi yesibuko).
jurisdictions_federation.the_operator_s_: Uhlu lokulungiselela lomsebenzi — okuluhlaza kulungile, okuphuzi isinyathelo esingakaqediwe, okubomvu isithakazelo esivimbayo. Hlanganisa nokuhlola ontanga (ngezansi) ukuze uqinisekise indlela yedatha yezinhlangothi zombili ngaphambi kwamagesi okuqinisekisa.
jurisdictions_federation.the_peer_mesh_a: I-mesh yontanga neirekhodi ye-Full-Faith-&-Credit. Ontanga baqinisekisa ngesigayane se-Ed25519; yonke imizila evumelanisiwe ihlolwa ngokwemishini yontanga ngaphambi kokuba isetshenziswe, futhi irekhodi lendawo yegunya le nkinga enegunya alisoze labhalwa kabusha.
jurisdictions_federation.this_instance_i: Le nkinga ikhophi yesibuko efunda kuphela yomphathi {shortId} (isimo: {membership_state}). Ayigcini lutho njengegunya futhi ayemukeli izifayela zomthethosisekelo. Yamukelwa {new}.
jurisdictions_federation.to_run_the_dns_: Ukuze usebenze njengendima yebroker ye-DNS/TLS, faka i-Cloudflare DNS-edit token yewona wonke amadome ozowibrokera. I-token igcinwe ishifwe kule bhokisi kuphela — ayifedereti, ayiveli kunoma iyiphi impendulo, futhi ayikwazi ukufundwa lapha. Ngemuva kwalokhu (kanye ne-lego ku-PATH), le bhokisi ifanele i-broker.dns / broker.tls.
